name: Used Vehicle Purchase Agreement
description: The contract for the sale of a used car or truck, from a dealer or between individuals. The checks read for the vehicle's identification number and odometer reading, the price and each fee added to it, the statement that the window form is part of the contract, the warranty or an as-is sale, and title free of liens.

title_keywords: vehicle bill of sale and purchase agreement

compliance_matrix_columns: The vehicle, by VIN and odometer reading
The price, and each fee added to it
Statement that the window form is part of the contract
Warranty, or a sale as is
Title, and any lien on the vehicle
